newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Anglo-Russian operation nets 200 kg of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Anglo-Russian operation nets 200 kg of cocaine.

text.p: Russian police seized 200 kg of cocaine concealed in tins of pineapple after a tip-off from British customs officials, the British embassy in Moscow said on Tuesday.

Police arrested seven people in the Siberian town of Bratsk after the consignment, first detected by British customs officials while en route for St Petersburg, was allowed to proceed to its destination, the embassy said in a statement.
The cocaine haul, valued at more than $40 million and originating in South America, is the biggest ever destined for the Russian market, it said.
Last month British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook and Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov agreed to step up co-operation in the fight against crime, including drug smuggling.
